items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...he made these records with Johnny Dodds quite often [INTERVIEWEE] he had a six piece band

ctx.x: Buster he was playing bells and vibraphones and doubling on drums and so I went out there and so we made cream with all of them and Norman Buster he wanted me to play a little bit on drums because Charlie hadn't ever dreamed I was playing drums until he heard Bobby and his band and I went make that ring so Charlie says to me I'll put you in my band on drums I said I appreciate you thinking that much of and trying to give me my second start in the way of life because if I stayed with you I would have been playing…

I was going to ask also since Jimmy Blythe isn't around I never did get to hear him in person or meet him if you know anything about him where he came from I have no information at all except he made those records with you and with those piano duets with Dodds and different people he

was born in Lexington Kentucky really from Lexington I don't know ! He was in Lexington Kentucky and two sisters he was the only boy and he was the youngest and they babied him like nobody's business and he was
